verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a payments platform that holds user cards, tokens, mandates and transaction records, so the axis applies. The pack documents no bulk export of user data, open export formats, or account offboarding. The openly published Trusted Agent Protocol spec and reference implementation show protocol openness, which is adjacent and not a user data-export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
